summary: Tiziana Life Sciences filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated November 5, 2026, announcing an investor conference call and webcast with key opinion leaders to discuss positive topline Phase 2a INFORM-MS results for intranasal foralumab in non-active secondary progressive multiple sclerosis. The 50 microgram dose showed a statistically significant reduction in microglial activation on TSPO PET (p=0.0168), with clinically meaningful fatigue improvements across both dose arms after 12 weeks. No transaction, stake, price, board recommendation or advisor is disclosed; the filing is a routine clinical-results communication, not a special situation. Watch for pivotal-trial guidance and financing needs.
